_doc: Tool-description diet budgets (build 2026-10-08 A2-3; coding/tool-description-budget.test.ts). A top-level description may be at most maxChars, a parameter description at most maxParamChars — unless its row below allows more (the post-diet length of a tool that still needs it). The lint fails only on NEW or LONGER text; never raise a row without a one-line justification in the PR — move the why (incident, ticket, date) into a code comment instead.
